title: feat(devx): the dispatcher vocabulary gate learns the APIError argument position
body:
Fixes #15723

Clause-②: no
Reason: this NARROWS the accept set, it does not widen it. A stamping position no gate could see becomes one where every emitted member must already be registered; no code becomes newly acceptable. Nothing in `packages/spec`, no schema, no wire contract and no published type surface is touched — the diff is one repo-root gate script.

## What was blind

`APIError.from(status, record)` copies `record.code` onto the body it builds, so the ARGUMENT is the stamp. When that record is a member expression on an imported code table — `BASE_ERROR_CODES.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL`, better-auth's own documented idiom, live in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` — the member NAME is the code, because `defineErrorCodes` maps each KEY to `{ code: that key, message }`.

Every pattern in both vocabulary gates is anchored on the token `code`: `objlit` / `objlitconst` / `objlitexpr` need a `code:`, `assign*` need a `.code =`, and `check:error-code-casing` needs a QUOTED literal beside `code`. The argument position carries none of the three. So it produced no site AND no unresolved — the one way this gate's "REPORTED as unresolved, never dropped" bound cannot notice itself failing, a fourth instance after #9223's, #13233's and #13790's.

## Baseline, reproduced before any edit

The card's controlled measurement, re-run on today's `origin/main` (`2d3d1c969`). The mutation is confirmed on disk by BOTH an occurrence count and a distinct `git hash-object`, and the restore is proven by blob equality plus an empty `git diff HEAD` — never by an exit code.

```
HEAD blob            = c19c00ba9e6613ded8f4e18a688286f6a74de81f
before hash          = c19c00ba9e6613ded8f4e18a688286f6a74de81f
before occurrences   = 1
after  hash          = e2f9f9600040d70f16fe5378004de76a6de7b2da
after  occurrences   = 0
mutation CONFIRMED on disk (hash changed, occurrences 1 -> 0)
MUTATED check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary EXIT=0
gate output mentions the code: 0
restored hash        = c19c00ba9e6613ded8f4e18a688286f6a74de81f
restore PROVEN: hash == HEAD blob, git diff HEAD empty
```

Exit 0 with the registration absent, and the code is not so much as named in the output. The gate's green carried no information about this shape.

## After — the SAME ablation, both directions

Re-run from the committed fix (`665a04a07`), the identical script, the identical mutation:

```
mutation CONFIRMED on disk (hash changed, occurrences 1 -> 0)
MUTATED check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary EXIT=1
gate output mentions the code: 3
restored hash        = c19c00ba9e6613ded8f4e18a688286f6a74de81f
restore PROVEN: hash == HEAD blob, git diff HEAD empty
```

```
[unclassified-site] packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts stamps unregistered code
'USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL' (apierrorarg) and
packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-error-vocabulary.ts does not classify it.
      That file is inside the published face, so the way out is the LEDGER: register
      'USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL' in packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts ...
```

Site total moves 52 to 53 under the ablation; the finding names the new shape by name. The other direction is the restored run: registration present, `EXIT=0`, 52 sites, no finding. Both directions, from the committed state, with the restore proven by bytes.

## Every call the new scan position reaches on main, enumerated

Derived through this gate's OWN primitives (`SHAPES`, `sliceBalanced`, `splitTopLevel`, `importedBindings`, `walkSources`) over the scanned population, so the probe is the shape and not a paraphrase of it. What it looked for: every `new APIError(` / `APIError.from(` call in non-test `packages/**` source, then argument ONE of each, classified — and for every class, which code (if any) reaches the wire and whether it is registered.

```
admin-impersonate-endpoint.ts:214  bare id       -> local record, code 'YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_IMPERSONATE_USERS'  objlit, not registered (declared row)
admin-impersonate-endpoint.ts:217  bare id       -> local record, code 'USER_NOT_FOUND'                             objlit, not registered (declared row)
admin-impersonate-endpoint.ts:225  bare id       -> local record, code 'YOU_CANNOT_IMPERSONATE_ADMINS'              objlit, not registered (declared row)
admin-impersonate-endpoint.ts:237  bare id       -> local record, code 'FAILED_TO_CREATE_USER'                      objlit, not registered (declared row)
auth-manager.ts:1144               object lit    -> no code key (vendor default for the status)
auth-manager.ts:1952               object lit    -> 'SSO_REGISTER_FORBIDDEN'            objlit, REGISTERED
auth-manager.ts:1999               object lit    -> 'ENV_ACCESS_DENIED'                 objlit, REGISTERED
auth-manager.ts:2098               object lit    -> LAST_LOCAL_CREDENTIAL_CODE          objlitconst, resolves + REGISTERED
auth-manager.ts:2138               object lit    -> refusal.error (runtime)             #9460 out-of-reach bound
auth-manager.ts:2189               MEMBER EXPR   -> 'USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL'  apierrorarg, REGISTERED   (the card's site)
auth-manager.ts:3012,3020,3073,3083,3101,3183,5143   object lit -> no code key (vendor default for the status)
auth-manager.ts:6933,6954          object lit    -> REMOVE_MEMBER_DENIAL_CODE           objlitconst, resolves + REGISTERED
auth-manager.ts:7005               object lit    -> REVOKE_SESSION_NOT_FOUND_CODE       objlitconst, resolves + REGISTERED
auth-manager.ts:7064               object lit    -> ADMIN_REVOKE_USER_SESSION_NOT_FOUND_CODE  objlitconst, resolves + REGISTERED
auth-manager.ts:7498               object lit    -> 'PASSWORD_POLICY_VIOLATION'         objlit, REGISTERED
auth-manager.ts:7881               object lit    -> 'PASSWORD_REUSE'                    objlit, REGISTERED
auth-manager.ts:7965               object lit    -> 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED'                    objlit, REGISTERED
impersonation-bearer-rotation.ts:259,282  object lit -> 'IMPERSONATION_ROTATION_FAILED' objlit, not registered (declared row)
list-user-invitations-verification.ts:189 bare id -> local record EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED_FOR_INVITATION  objlit
objectql-adapter.ts:598            object lit    -> 'VALIDATION_FAILED'                 objlit, REGISTERED
objectql-adapter.ts:609            object lit    -> 'PERMISSION_DENIED'                 objlit, REGISTERED
objectql-adapter.ts:619            object lit    -> 'DELETE_RESTRICTED'                 objlit, REGISTERED
```

30 candidate calls in 5 files: 24 object literals, 5 bare identifiers, 1 member expression, 0 with no second argument. **Exactly one** member expression exists on this tree, its object IS an imported binding, its member IS in ADR-0112 D1's value space — and it is REGISTERED, by #15587. So the widening adds 0 sites, 0 verdict rows and 0 unresolved entries today, and the scanned site total is unchanged at 52.

That zero is a reading, not a silence: the probe enumerated all 30 calls and printed what each puts on the wire. The `not registered` rows are pre-existing `objlit` sites already carried in `UNREGISTERED_CODE_SITES` — the new shape neither adds nor removes any of them, and guard ② is precisely why it does not annex them.

Nothing was missed on this tree. What this shape can still not see is stated in the header and in the printed bounds: a code the VENDOR emits from inside its own routes (the `invite_only` lane the card measured) is written in no source in this repo, so no source scan reaches it. Closing that needs a declared, audited vendor allow-list — option C, a separate decision about the accept set, deliberately not taken here.

## What landed

One new published shape, `apierrorarg`, with four structural guards, each carrying positive AND negative `--self-test` fixtures:

1. **argument ONE only.** Argument zero is the HTTP status NAME (`'UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY'`) — better-call vocabulary, not an ADR-0112 code. Reading it would invent a finding at all 30 calls.
2. **a member expression only.** An object literal there carries its own `code:` and is `objlit` / `objlitconst`'s; a bare identifier names a local record whose own object literal they read. Annexing either would derive one site twice under two names — the double-count a published shape list has no way to notice. The fixtures assert BOTH halves: no `apierrorarg` site, and the sibling shape still reports the code.
3. **the object must be a binding the file IMPORTS** (`importedBindings`) — three declared spellings, each pinned: static `import`, `const {…} = await import()` (the live one), and `const [{…}] = await Promise.all([import(…)])` (live in `admin-impersonate-endpoint.ts`, confirmed by reading the `Promise.all` argument list for an `import(` rather than trusting the array pattern).
4. **the member must be spelled `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`** — a table whose keys are not codes cannot have a key read as one.

Guards 3 and 4 fail LOUD: a member expression the shape cannot turn into a code is reported as `unresolved` with reason `vendor-member`, so an import spelling `importedBindings` does not know REDS this gate instead of going quiet. That inverts the usual price of a textual recogniser, and it is deliberate — at this position silence IS the defect.

Option B (registering the vendor table wholesale) is refused on the card's own stated cost: it would make this repo's accept set follow a vocabulary it does not own. The header and the printed bounds both say so, so the refusal is collectable rather than remembered.

## Verification

Nothing existing was relaxed. `git diff` shows the `objlit` / `objlitconst` / `objlitexpr` / `assign*` / `codehelper` / `objlithelper` regexes byte-unchanged, no `--self-test` case removed, and the shape count 10 to 11.

- `pnpm check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` :: exit 0 — self-test `11 shapes + 396 assertions OK` (was 10 shapes + 352), gate `OK — 52 unregistered code-stamping site(s), all classified`.
- New self-test battery `[#15723] THE APIError ARGUMENT POSITION: the record is the stamp.` — floor 44, and it registers exactly 44 (verified by temporarily pinning the floor to 999 and reading back the count the failure prints).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran RANFILE` :: **32 derived families, 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** — a DERIVED zero, every family recorded with its exit code captured before any pipe, and none is 3.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide `eslint . --no-inline-config`) :: exit 0. No narrowing to declare.
- Extra, because `dispatch-gates` flags them as keeping a roster under `scripts/`: `check-published-list-mirrors` and its self-test, `check:console-injection`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check-skills-token-ratchet` and its self-test — all exit 0. `check:error-code-casing` (whose `findViolations` this gate imports) and `@objectstack/spec check:error-code-provenance` — both exit 0, unchanged.
- `packages/spec` `error-code-ledger.test.ts` :: 20 passed — the ledger file the ablation mutated is byte-identical to HEAD.
- **NOT MEASURED:** `check:published-readme-exports` — exit 3, prerequisite not met (40 packages have no built `dist/*.d.ts` in this worktree). Not one of this card's 32 derived families, and its population is untouched by construction: the diff edits no package source, no README and nothing inside any package's `files[]`.

No changeset. Measured, not assumed: the only edited path is repo-root `scripts/`, the root manifest is `private: true`, and no published manifest's `files[]` escapes its own directory — so nothing published moves.

## Acceptance notes

Out of scope, noted and not filed:

- `packages/spec/scripts/check-error-code-provenance.ts` states its own bounds (`patterns = objlit, assign, constdef`) and is blind to this position too. It is `domain:spec`'s and triage said in as many words ⛔ 不要在本卡的 PR 里顺手扩面 — untouched here. Successor: whoever widens that gate on its own card.
- The `Promise.all([import(…)])` import form and `importedBindings`' file-scoped (not lexically scoped) reading are both declared bounds with fixtures, not silent approximations. Successor: none needed — a spelling they miss reds the gate rather than hiding a code.
